common_input: Same 142 chunks, corpus/model snapshot, original question text and explicit chapter scope. Gold/answerability labels never enter model/tool inputs.
evaluation_notes: Compare at least 3 retrieval methods and at least 2 measured improvement configurations.
Report original-query Hit@1 and Evidence Hit@3 at the same cutoff, independent of candidate-pool size.
Answerable cases only enter retrieval/context/grounded-answer denominators; insufficient cases enter abstention metrics.
Citation validity requires context membership AND actual support, not just a valid ID.
Runtime errors are reported separately; do not replace failures with abstentions or fake scores.
Cost missing from a run is unknown, not zero; local inference can report zero paid API cost with appropriate resource disclosure.
Select on dev, seal configuration before test, then compare baseline and selected configuration on the same 7 test cases.
Do not tune or select using test results; authoring/source-verification is distinct from inspecting test retrieval/model results.
authorship: AI-assisted benchmark construction and source/absence review. Student understanding/review remains necessary.
carryover_limitations: Corpus/chunks were already studied in Day 6, including related concepts. New test question strings are distinct from the Day 6 benchmark, but this is not independent data or an untouched corpus.
